title: China Warns Against Renewed U.S. Chip Curbs Amid Nvidia Jensen Huang Scandal
summary: U.S. lawmakers have called for tighter restrictions on China's access to advanced AI chips following allegations involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy.
